text: SIF/SIS Flexible Feeding & Tray-Loading for Electronics | MAIBIDA

A parallel (Delta) structure paired with the in-house AtomCV vision positioning system, designed for precision loading, unloading, sorting, and tray loading in the electronics, hardware, food, and pharmaceutical industries. Multiple models cover 0.3–1kg payloads and a range of working strokes, with custom vibratory bowls and hoppers available.
A Parallel Feeding Solution Built for Precision Manufacturing

The vision-guided parallel (Delta) feeding robot handles picking, sorting, and tray loading at high speed, with high precision and flexibility. From miniature electronic components to regular hardware parts, vision guidance enables stable loading and unloading, reducing manual handling and missed inspections.
The standard model is equipped with a Hikvision 12 MP CCD; the in-house AtomCV_1.2 control system delivers high-precision positioning and recognition.
Repeat positioning accuracy ±0.05mm and placement accuracy ±0.15mm maintain a stable cycle time even at high speed.
SIF series: 0.3–1kg payload and Ø300–Ø800 working range; SIS series: flexible combinations of pick-up units.
Vibratory bowls, hoppers, and special tray surfaces can be customized to suit different part geometries and line layouts.
Two Series Covering All Loading Scenarios

The SIF series is the parallel (Delta) feeding robot itself, focused on high-speed handling and tray loading; the SIS series is a pick-up/feeding unit designed for easy line integration. The two series can be combined as needed to cover loading and unloading from micro components to medium payloads.

Instant Full Inspection with 0.2 s Response
The moment parts are ejected from the injection mold, a high-speed camera and synchronized strobe light work together to inspect all 16 mold cavities immediately, with no delay in defect detection,
and no extra waiting step is required.
360° Visual Inspection with No Blind Spots

The intelligent main unit combines multi-angle ring lighting for uniform illumination across the whole area with a high-definition high-speed camera, so even tiny flaws and short shots are captured during inspection,
In-house core AI algorithms are tailored to short-shot detection for different products, removing the need for repeated tuning and handling diverse production scenarios with ease.

Nonconforming parts are sorted automatically by a robot, with no additional equipment required and lower labor costs; inspection data connects to the enterprise MES system in real time, supporting statistical
analysis, big-data traceability, and production optimization.
Distance, height, and spacing are freely adjustable for flexible setup; the unit mounts securely, fits a range of injection molding machines, and adapts to different production layouts.
